info.title: Cooper API
info.description: Cooper IT Service Management REST API (FR-API-001).

get.summary: Lists Analysts.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on name (and email or code where relevant).

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Restrict to one Company (Requesters and Cost Centres).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Only these records: UUIDs separated by commas, at most 200 (Requesters only).

post.summary: Creates an Analyst (needs `analysts.manage`; Administrators only for `is_admin`).

get.summary: Loads an Analyst.

put.summary: Replaces an Analyst's username, email, name and Administrator flag.
Replaces the Company access granted directly to an Analyst.

post.summary: Deactivates an Analyst and ends their sessions.

put.summary: Sets an Analyst's password and ends their sessions.

post.summary: Reactivates an Analyst.

put.summary: Replaces the Roles assigned directly to an Analyst.

post.summary:
Resets an Analyst's two-factor sign-in (lost phone). Ends their sessions.
Administrators only.

get.summary:
Assets in your Companies, newest first; retired Assets only when asked for (needs
`assets.read`).

Active and retired Asset counts, active Assets per type and status (needs
`assets.read`; FR-AST-005).

already checked-out Asset cannot be checked out.

(FR-AST-006).

in first; retired Assets are excluded from active counts and lists.

get.summary: Background Jobs with their schedules and latest run (needs `system.manage`).

get.summary: Calendar Categories, Administrators' first, by name (FR-CAL-001).

post.summary: Adds a Calendar Category (needs `calendar.configure`).

put.summary:
Changes a Calendar Category (needs `calendar.configure`). System categories may be
renamed and recoloured but not deactivated.

get.summary:
Calendar Events of the Companies you can see touching a range of days, manual and
generated (FR-CAL-001, FR-CAL-002).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description:
Last day, inclusive (required; at most 366 days after `from`). Timed events are
matched on their UTC days.

get.summary: One Calendar Event.

put.summary: Changes a manual Calendar Event (needs `calendar.update`; generated events: `409`).

get.summary: Every Capability Roles may contain.
Changes scheduled in a period, with conflicts (FR-CHG-012).
Risk Levels by score (FR-CHG-005).

put.summary:
Replaces the Risk Levels; together they must cover scores 1–25 exactly once (needs
`changes.configure`).

get.summary: Change Templates; Analysts see those usable by one of their Teams.

post.summary: Creates a Change Template (needs `changes.configure`).

put.summary:
Changes a Change Template; new content makes a new version, Changes keep the version
they were created from (needs `changes.configure`).

get.summary: Changes in your Companies, newest activity first (needs `changes.read`).

parameters.name: awaiting_my_vote
parameters.description: Waiting for my vote (Approver or CAB member of the open round).

post.summary: Creates a Change in Draft (needs `changes.create`).

get.summary: One Change.

put.summary:
Edits a Change. A material edit while awaiting approval or approved returns it to
Awaiting Approval with a new Approval Round (needs `changes.update`).

get.summary: Files attached to a Change.

post.summary:
Uploads a file (multipart field `file`); the media type is detected from the content
(needs `changes.update`).

get.summary: Downloads an attached file (always as a download, never rendered inline).
The CAB of a Change.

put.summary: Replaces the CAB while the Change is in Draft (needs `changes.update`).

get.summary: The implementation checklist.

put.summary: Changes or ticks a checklist item (needs `changes.update`).

get.summary: Comments, oldest first.

post.summary: Adds a comment (needs `changes.update`).

get.summary: Linked tickets, Problems and Changes (FR-CHG-008).

post.summary: Links a ticket, Problem or Change of the same Company (needs `changes.update`).

get.summary:
Revisions of one long text field (`description`, `reason_for_change`,
`risk_evaluation`, `test_plan`, `rollback_plan`), oldest first (FR-CHG-009).
Line comparison of two revisions of a field.

post.summary: Moves a Change to another status, following the stage order (needs `changes.update`).

get.summary: Votes of an Approval Round.

post.summary:
Votes in the current Approval Round as Approver or CAB member; the last deciding
vote approves or rejects the Change (needs `changes.approve`).

get.summary: Live Updates for the signed-in Analyst (Server-Sent Events, ADR-0022).
get.description:
Events: `ready` once changes are being received (refetch on every `ready` after the
first: changes may have been missed while disconnected); `invalidate` with
`{"topic":"ticket"|"ticket_presence"|"change","id":"…"}` when a ticket the Analyst
may see (or who has it open) or a Change they may read changed; `resync`
when everything should be read again. Events never contain record data.

Needs the Analyst session cookie; API keys and Portal sessions are refused.

401.description: Not signed in with an Analyst session

get.summary: Lists Mailboxes with their health (needs `tickets.configure`).

post.summary:
Creates a Mailbox; `password` (IMAP) or `credentials` (Microsoft, Google) are stored
encrypted.

get.summary:
The provider redirects here after the account consented (or refused). Stores the
refresh token, encrypted, and redirects to the Mailboxes screen with
`?mailbox_consent=connected&mailbox=<id>` (needs the same Analyst session that started
the consent).

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: The provider's error code, when the account refused.

put.summary:
Replaces a Mailbox's settings; the stored secret is kept unless `password` or
`credentials` is given.

post.summary:
Runs a Connection Check (FR-EML-013): signs in with the saved settings and secret and
opens the folder, without reading or changing mail. A failed sign-in is a 200 with
`ok: false` and the reason; health is left to the poller (needs `tickets.configure`).

Starts Mailbox Consent for a Microsoft `delegated` or Google Mailbox whose client
credentials are saved (needs `tickets.configure`, in an Analyst session).

get.summary: Recent Rejected Emails of a Mailbox (Whitelist, unknown senders, loop protection).
Every Module and whether it is on (for navigation).

put.summary: Turns a Module on or off (needs `system.manage`).

get.summary: Checks in your Companies, active or not, in round order (needs `morning-checks.read`).

Clears a Check Result: the Check is unrecorded again for that date, and the result's

Creates a follow-up Task from a result, routed like the Check and carrying its notes,
and links it (needs `morning-checks.record` and `tasks.create`).

sign-in. Without it the response is `401` with type `totp-required`.

hours.description:
Working hours Monday to Sunday: seven entries, each `{start, end}` (`HH:MM`) or
`null` for a day off.

is_default.description: Used for Priorities without their own calendar.

paused_at.description: When the clock was paused, if it is.

responded_at.description: When the first response was recorded.

SlaReportDto.description: SLA compliance of tickets created in a period.

total.description: Every ticket created in the period.

id.description: The Priority, Queue or Company (`null` for none and for periods and the total).

period.description: The day or first day of the month (`by=period`).

remaining_seconds.description:
Seconds until due (negative when overdue); absent when met, paused or without a
target.

until.description: Hidden from default views until then.

SplitRequest.description: Splits emails and Notes off a ticket.

subject.description: Subject of the new ticket (default: the same subject).

SsoProviderDto.description: An OIDC provider (FR-IAM-012). The client secret is write-only.

has_client_secret.description: Whether a secret is stored (output only).

link_by_verified_email.description: Link a first sign-in by verified email.

incidents.description: Incidents with public updates (only when shown; FR-PRT-006).

planned_maintenance.description: Scheduled and started Planned Maintenance, soonest first.

services.description: Active Services with their Current Status, in order.

StatusRequest.description: Move a ticket to another status.

closure_category_id.description: Closure Category (required when closing, if configured).

company_id.description: Company (create only; absent: shared with every Company).

is_active.description: Shown and selectable (deactivate instead of deleting).

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page.

SwitchRequesterRequest.description: Switch the Requester a Portal session acts as.

breached_open.description: Not satisfied yet and past due.

compliance.description: `met / (met + breached)` in percent, one decimal; `null` when nothing is decided.

running.description: Not satisfied yet, not past due (or paused).

has_more.description: More Tasks than `limit` are in this column.

tasks.description: Its top-level Tasks in Board order.

tags.description: Tags.

TaskHistoryDto.description: One change in a Task's history.

is_done.description: Statuses: finished by completing (repeats on completion).

TaskLookupRequest.description: Creates or changes a Task Status or Priority.

index.description: Place in the column, 0-based (absent: keep the position).

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page.

rule.description:
The rule: `frequency` (`daily`, `weekly` with `weekdays`, `monthly` with `on` =
`day_of_month` (`day`) or `nth_weekday` (`nth`, `weekday`), `yearly` with `month`
and `day`), `interval`, `mode` (`on_completion` or `fixed`), and `ends` (`never`,
`on_date` with `date`, `after_count` with `count`).
The rule (see the response), or null to stop repeating.

collaborator_ids.description: Collaborators (create only; use the collaborators endpoint afterwards).

company_id.description: Company (create only; a Subtask takes its parent's).

parent_task_id.description: Parent, to create a Subtask (create only).

tags.description: Tags.

by_status.description: Open top-level Tasks per chosen open status.

company_access.description: Company access granted to the Team.

TicketCountReportDto.description: Ticket counts by one dimension: a Dashboard Widget.

oneOf.description: The period of creation, when one was asked for.

rows.description: Rows: reference data in its order, others by name; `(none)` last.

id.description: The status, Priority, … (`null` for tickets without one).

deleted_at.description: When it was deleted (Administrators only see deleted tickets).

merged_into_id.description: The ticket this one was merged into (FR-TKT-026).

total_minutes.description: Total minutes of Time Entries (single-ticket responses only).

ask_requester.description: Asked of the Requester on the Portal.

required_on_close.description: Required before a ticket can be closed.

required_on_create.description: Required when a ticket is created by an Analyst or on the Portal.

type_ids.description: Ticket Types it applies to; empty for every type.

TicketLinkDto.description: A Ticket Link seen from one ticket (FR-TKT-028).

relation.description:
`related`, `duplicate_of`, `duplicated_by`, `parent_of` or `child_of`, from the
requested ticket's side.

TicketMergeDto.description: A merge of one ticket into another (FR-TKT-026).

id.description: ID (use it to undo the merge).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

fields.description:
Ticket Field values by key (create only; use `PUT /tickets/{id}/fields`
afterwards). FR-TKT-029.

team_id.description: Queue (create only; use the assignment endpoint afterwards).

id.description: ID (use it to undo the split).

oneOf.description: The new ticket (only right after splitting).

source_ticket_id.description: The ticket the rows came from.

by_status.description: Open tickets per chosen open status.

high_priorities.description: The Priorities counted as high, with their open tickets.

high_priority.description: Open tickets of a high Priority.

TicketTypeRuleConditionsDto.description: Conditions of a Ticket Type Rule; empty lists are ignored.

requester_domains.description: Requester email domains; subdomains match too.

subject_keywords.description: Words or phrases; any one in the subject matches (ignoring case).

conditions.description: Conditions; all non-empty ones must match.

TileCountDto.description: One value on a Watchtower tile.

attention.description: Counts towards the tile's "needs attention" figure.

TimeReportDto.description: Time Entries per Analyst, Team, Company or period.

includes_tasks.description: Whether Task Time Entries are included (Tasks Module on and `tasks.read`).

id.description: The Analyst, Team or Company (`null` for none and for periods and the total).

period.description: The day or first day of the month (`by=period`).

data.description: The Note, Time Entry or change (`{action, changes: [{field, old_value, new_value}]}`).

code.description: Six-digit code from the authenticator app.

otpauth_uri.description: `otpauth://` URI to show as a QR code.

secret.description: The secret in base32, for manual entry into an authenticator app.

UserGroupRequest.description: Creates or changes a User Group.

ViewerDto.description: Another Analyst who has the ticket open (FR-TKT-025).

VolumeReportDto.description: Created and closed per day or month (created vs closed).

rows.description: One row per day or month, empty ones included.

VolumeRowDto.description: Tickets created and closed in one day or month.

period.description: The day, or the first day of the month.

oneOf.description: Morning Checks (`null` when the Module is off or without `morning-checks.read`).
Tasks (`null` when the Tasks Module is off or without `tasks.read`).

today.description: Today in the instance time zone.

task_statuses.description: Open Task Statuses counted one by one.

ticket_statuses.description: Open Ticket Statuses counted one by one.
